name: ANSI/IEEE Magnetoresistive element form
summary: IEEE-library form of magnetoresistive element: this representation identifies a resistive element whose response is associated with a magnetic field.
description: This reference locates magnetoresistive element in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented resistive components family. This representation identifies a resistive element whose response is associated with a magnetic field. The component is a resistive sensing element associated with a magnetic field. It can participate in a larger measurement circuit rather than providing a ready-made contact output. The public library uses HVR1S00689 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Follow the actual current path and terminal polarity in the surrounding circuit. The symbol identifies an electrical function; voltage, current, energy limits and the device package pinout come from the selected component data rather than from the outline.

Identify any bridge, conditioning or controller input associated with the element. A magnetically operated switch has a different electrical output description. Document the sensing circuit and output conditioning separately. A magnetoresistive element is distinct from a magnetic contact switch. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
